name: Mjortvyj les
source:
In search of a single answer to one question that has long tormented him, the cursed animal Laki approaches the mysterious dark wood called the Dead Forest. But he will not manage to travel alone - Laki encounters Claude, a spider who is odd just like he is. What will Laki discover about his companion and about himself? What do the ancient ruins hide? Will he be able to find the right path among the tangled trails of the Dead Forest, where such a path is easy to miss?

[From [url=https://games-manul.itch.io/dead-forest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了找到那个长久困扰自己的问题的答案，受到诅咒的动物拉基走近了一片名为“死寂森林”的神秘幽林。然而，他无法独自走完这段旅程——拉基遇到了和自己一样古怪的蜘蛛克劳德。他会发现同伴与自身怎样的秘密？古老的废墟中又隐藏着什么？死寂森林的小径错综复杂，正确的道路稍不留神便会错过，他能找到属于自己的方向吗？

[摘自[url=https://games-manul.itch.io/dead-forest]itch.io[/url]]
